IncidentDef.label: Tok'ra hidden safehouse
IncidentDef.letterText: Your colonists have completed a stored Tok'ra safehouse lead. A temporary non-hostile safehouse is now visible on the world map and can be visited by caravan for {TRETONINCOUNT} tretonin dose(s) and {MEDICINECOUNT} industrial medicine unit(s). One safehouse lead was consumed. Remaining safehouse leads: {LEADCOUNT}/{LEADMAX}.
